description: UX Pilot helps users create wireframes, high-fidelity UI screens, and multi-screen app flows from natural-language prompts inside ChatGPT. Single-screen requests start generation in the user's UX Pilot workspace right away and show a live preview widget. Multi-screen flow requests first suggest screens; the user confirms selections in the widget before designs are generated. Users can open results in UX Pilot to continue editing.

defaultPrompt: Create a wireframe for a icecream shop website
